name: green_harp
description: Concert harp, single plucked notes like water running off a leaf, then one rising arpeggio when the canopy opens.
character: Concert harp, single plucked notes like water running off a leaf, then one rising arpeggio when the canopy opens.
sources: KB western (orchestral weight: low strings and timpani carry the pulse, horns the theme, brass and chorus the weight)
KB dynamic-flow (the arc comes from layers and register, not volume alone)
KB video-scoring (structural moments are preceded by a drop in density)
Sonatina Symphonic Orchestra, CC Sampling Plus 1.0, https://github.com/peastman/sso (free multisampled, dry, looped sustains; not a commercial library)
ESTIMATE: azimuth, distance, level and EQ are starting values for this piece, not measured; trim_db is set after the first measured render
